verdict.rationale: Bland documents post-call webhooks that automatically deliver HTTP notifications after a call completes (bland-docs-5), plus evals/LLM-judge scoring (bland-docs-7, -22) and pathway-based structured prompting (bland-docs-18) that could feed structured outputs. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a structured extraction schema (entities, dispositions, outcome fields) delivered in the webhook payload or via API. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of structured field extraction (entities/dispositions/outcomes) in webhook/API payloads, and independent confirmation of extraction accuracy.
